purpose: Receiving-side Marketing faculty research; extend geography independently of the fixed 58-program doctoral placement scope.
selection_rule: Australia: all eight current Group of Eight members, verified from the Go8 official member board. Macao: University of Macau, Macau University of Science and Technology and City University of Macau, selected for their official business/Marketing academic units. The Macao selection is an explicit first research scope, not an asserted ranking of universities or employment outcomes.
person_rule: Start with each official current Marketing roster. For combined Management and Marketing/Business directories, verify Marketing affiliation or substantive research individually and retain exclusions. Research, teaching, practice, visiting, emeritus and honorary roles remain separate. Separately identified Economics IO profiles may be retained with explicit IO evidence, including Economics departments; these are additional discovery samples, not part of Marketing roster completeness or a census of Economics departments.
completeness_rule: Directory reconciliation concerns only the stated unit, appointment category and source snapshot. It does not establish complete doctoral cohorts or complete career histories. A partly inaccessible or ambiguous directory remains partial even when several faculty profiles can be verified.
